# DON'T ANSWER [italic]Stories from the treeline. Most of them are just stories. Keep the fire going anyway.[/italic]
Every colony with trees has a story about something out in them that calls your name. This board started as a place to swap those stories on long shifts. Then people started posting things that were not stories, and we stopped laughing about it, and here we are.
[color=#E6E1D3][bold]IF SOMEONE YOU LOVE IS CALLING YOU FROM THE TREES, THEY ARE NOT IN THE TREES.[/bold][/color]
## THE RULES OF THE FIRE - [bold]Do not answer.[/bold] Not your name, not who is there, not a joke. It learns from what you give it. - [bold]Do not follow.[/bold] The people you know are indoors. Go and check. Then stay indoors with them. - [bold]Count heads.[/bold] At the fire, at the truck, at the door. If the count is right and you hear one more voice, leave. - [bold]No sound files.[/bold] Transcripts only. Ask the mods why if you want, they will tell you. - [bold]Do not go looking for where it sleeps.[/bold] Nobody who posted that they would ever posted again.

## A NOTE FROM THE KEEPER I do not know what it is. Nobody here does. Some say it is an animal that copies sounds the way a mynah bird does. Some say it is a person, or was. Some say the Company lost it, and some say the Company did not lose it at all, it put it there. I only know that the people who answer stop posting, and the people who do not answer are still here telling their stories.
If someone from your fire went into the trees after a voice and did not come back, put them on [netlink="lastseen.deep" link="lastseen.deep"]. Somebody there will keep a light on for them.
## NEW POSTS [color=#5C6B58]Anyone may post. Keep it to the fire. Posts run below.[/color]
